'''Magnus Hansson''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 104 from Eskilstuna, Swe. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

A computer specialist at IBM Global Services, he played from the game's release.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
